objective: Complete the required first pass through every eligible historical HDD training window, then evaluate the selected model.
decision: Request a graceful stop after the first completed epoch if its frozen validation loss is at most 0.01. Otherwise retain the original two-epoch or seven-hour limit.
necessity: Validation loss is low and the separate 32-device validation generation check shows numerical and order dependence. The optional second pass has no guaranteed benefit. Preserve shared compute for other component models.
data_splits: Unchanged 11,315,069 training windows and frozen 512 validation devices. No test or calibration inputs are released before final checkpoint selection.
updated_parameters: Unchanged temporal encoder, projector, rank-8 Gemma attention LoRA.
frozen_parameters: All original Gemma parameters and the original data, weights, and optimizer configuration.
hardware_cost: Existing eight-RTX PRO 6000 VM. Original $14.40/hour quote, shared $600 ceiling, and 08:34:30 UTC provider/controller stop deadline remain active.
stopping: Signal a verified training worker only after a completed-epoch checkpoint and validation score exist. Allow the distributed loop to save a terminal result. Do not stop before a full pass.
evaluation: Unchanged predeclared held-out success gate, numerical ablations, counterfactual comparisons, baselines, bootstrap intervals, and exact reload check.
outputs: Keep the selected checkpoint, terminal optimizer/cursor checkpoint, original training history, this amendment, export checksums, and final test results.
